basis: Monthly work plan: inverted-pendulum locomotion and control-frequency/delay analysis
scope: 2D hybrid LIPM stepping plus separate nonlinear finite-foot standing validation; no full-body biped walking claim

plant_failure.acceleration_friction_limit: norm(F_ground_xy) <= mu*m*g; F_ground_xy=m*g/h*(c-CoP); external push is excluded

recovery: First 0.5s continuous interval after push with 2D shifted-reference position error <0.02m and velocity error <0.08m/s, only if full horizon succeeds
measurement_noise: seeded 1mm position and 0.01m/s velocity, sampled from shared 1kHz timeline, not an IMU hardware model
prediction: Known input model propagation only; no true current state, force disturbance or future measurement is supplied
timing: All frequencies and delays in model time, not host hard realtime
parameter_policy: Freeze before formal grid; keep failed cases and report route changes separately
evaluation: All main LIPM error/success/recovery metrics use the common 1ms physics timeline, independent of control rate

physical_standing_success.posture_tube_last_0p5s: angle<0.02rad and angular speed<0.05rad/s at every physics sample
